results.name: S1 Deterministic ordering
results.notes: Target order normalization should produce identical key.

results.name: S2 Reason code changes key
results.notes: Reason code must be part of idempotency signature.

results.name: S3 Actor changes key
results.notes: Actor should change key to avoid cross-actor collisions.

results.name: S4 Action changes key
results.notes: Action name must be part of signature.

results.name: S5 Exact duplicate write
results.notes: Exact duplicate payload should be treated as idempotent no-op.

results.name: S6 Conflicting duplicate write
results.notes: Same key with different payload must fail closed.
